facts.fact: Tech Africa News reports that in February 2026 Paratus activated a 2,000-kilometre protected fibre route linking Mombasa to Goma via Nairobi, Kampala and Kigali, giving eastern DRC direct high-capacity access to subsea systems on the Kenyan coast; the document states capacity available and no traffic figures or named buyer.

facts.fact: Paratus said at the ITW and Datacloud Africa Conference that its 2,000 km Goma-to-Mombasa terrestrial fibre route, linking eastern DRC to Kenya via Kigali, Kampala and Nairobi, is live and carrying traffic.

Tanzania's foreign minister reaffirmed, in a meeting with the DRC ambassador, that the two countries are pursuing construction of a fibre-optic cable from Kigoma in Tanzania to Kalemie in DRC across Lake Tanganyika and agreed to fast-track it; no date of original agreement, contract, cost or works start is given.
